findings_summary: Both generation-1 publications are valid research evidence and address the same all-m critical-cofactor mother problem, but they freeze different durable frontiers. TP2-5547117E54D7A556279B preserves the 2026-08-26 FREE-researcher reduction: exact critical matrix, shifted-Newton/Jacobi transfer and a remaining uniform hook-nonvanishing lemma; its immutable result RR-2B648AB483422BD7A6CD is BLOCKED rather than a proof of failure. TP2-4EE2618ABEBB6D097023 is a later Driver-published current refocus under OBJ-ROUTE-A-PERFECT-PRIME-TABLE-CRITICAL-COFACTOR-ALL-M and explicitly incorporates additional discriminant, power-sum, Cauchy, integral/Schur and Vandermonde routes. The later publication does not invalidate or rewrite the earlier reduction.
